newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 10-mths pork exports surge 179 pct on yr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 10-mths pork exports surge 179 pct on yr.

text.p: South Korea's pork exports surged 179 percent to 31,840 tonnes in the first 10 months of this year from 11,430 tonnes a year earlier, an official at the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestries said on Thursday.
The ministry official said Japan has been the only destination for the South Korean pork. Japan is a major pork importer.
In value term, pork exports for the first 10 month also jumped 141 percent to $171 million from $71 million a year ago.
Of the total exports, 27,852 tonnes were frozen porks and 3,988 tonnes were refrigerated.
The ministry official said South Korea's total pork exports was expected to reach around 35,000 tonnes this year, bringing in more than $200 million.
